title: Jesus... My Best Friend Told Everyone My Secret?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, my best friend told everyone my secret?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Something I only ever said to her.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know. I was there when you told her.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why did You let her?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I let people be free. That is the same freedom that let her sit with you for nine years.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So I just forgive her and pretend it did not happen?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. Forgiving is not pretending. You can forgive her and still be careful with her.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone keeps saying get over it.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I am not saying that. What was taken from you was real.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I feel stupid for trusting her.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are not stupid for trusting. She is responsible for what she did with it. Do not move that weight onto yourself.

bible.text: Now instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow. I urge you, therefore, to reaffirm your love for him.
